informational.description: User wants to learn, understand, or troubleshoot.
informational.content_type: Guides, calculators, explainer blogs, FAQ sections.
informational.formatting: Clear headings, TL;DR summaries, visual callouts, step-by-step breakdowns.
informational.cta_type: Try our free tool / Read related guides

commercial_investigation.description: User is comparing affiliate networks, tools, or rates before committing.
commercial_investigation.content_type: Comparison tables, pros/cons lists, ROI calculators, rate benchmarks.
commercial_investigation.formatting: Side-by-side comparison tables, rating cards, key differences callout.
commercial_investigation.cta_type: Calculate your exact loss / Compare network payouts

transactional.description: User is ready to audit report, build links, or calculate specific figures.
transactional.content_type: Interactive calculator pages, URL submitter, directory listing forms.
transactional.formatting: Above-the-fold tool interface, minimal fluff, immediate input fields.

keyword_research.primary_target_rule: Every page must target exactly 1 primary keyword phrase.
keyword_research.secondary_keywords_rule: Include 3-5 LSI / long-tail variations naturally within subheadings and body text.
keyword_research.density_limit: Never exceed 1.5% keyword density; focus on semantic entity presence.
keyword_research.title_tag_rule: Primary keyword must appear within the first 60 characters of the page <title>.

topic_clustering.pillar_page_structure: Pillar articles provide high-level overview of a major topic (e.g. Amazon Affiliate Marketing) and link to 6-10 supporting cluster articles.
topic_clustering.cluster_supporting_rule: Supporting articles cover hyper-specific long-tail questions (e.g. Amazon Halo commission changes) and always link back to the pillar page with descriptive anchors.
topic_clustering.cannibalization_prevention: Never target the same primary keyword across multiple pages. Check existing sitemap before creating new topics.

semantic_seo.lsi_integration: Incorporate related terms naturally into H2/H3 headers and paragraph text.

internal_linking.anchor_text_rule: Use descriptive, natural anchor text (e.g. 'check Amazon commission rates') instead of generic phrases like 'click here' or repetitive exact-match keywords.
internal_linking.orphan_prevention: Every new article must be linked from at least 1 existing index/category/blog page.

eeat_and_affiliate_guidelines.experience: Reference real Amazon Associates report CSV structures, exact column names (Eligible Ships, Direct Earnings), and actual rate tables.
eeat_and_affiliate_guidelines.expertise: Provide precise mathematical formulas for break-even, commission loss, and net margin.
eeat_and_affiliate_guidelines.authoritativeness: Cite official Amazon Associates Operating Agreement rules, FTC guidance on affiliate links, and Open PageRank indices.
eeat_and_affiliate_guidelines.trustworthiness: Always include transparent affiliate disclosures, emphasize privacy (browser-only processing), and state independence from Amazon.
eeat_and_affiliate_guidelines.ftc_compliance: All external affiliate links must include rel="nofollow sponsored" attribute.
